historicalGate.denominator: strongest-raw-candidate independently for score, attack, and body

interpretation.brittleness: Among the 118 nontrivial retained secondaries, attack is the limiting dimension 57 times, body 47 times, and total score only 14 times. 61/118 survive within 0.05 of the hard floor and 94/118 within 0.10. The surviving boundary is therefore controlled primarily by the independent attack/body conjunction rather than total physical score.
interpretation.midi64: Only 15/202 primary-MIDI64 attacks retain any nontrivial secondary, versus 93/523 non64 attacks. This is a retained-survivorship disparity only; the unavailable suppressed rows prevent an exact claim about how many MIDI64 alternatives a relaxed rule would recover.
interpretation.nextSafeTest: Evaluate a source-only alternative such as strong total score plus either strong attack or strong body when full pre-precision rows become available; do not tune thresholds against professional mismatches.
interpretation.strongestRawSecondaryAccounting: All 144 promoted-fundamental attacks necessarily retain the strongest raw candidate; those 144 rows account for 144 of the 262 retained secondaries. Only 118 retained secondaries are nontrivial gate survivors.

nontrivialSecondarySurvivorship.definition: retained secondary excluding the strongest-raw candidate that is necessarily retained when a lower fundamental is promoted
